research_contract.current_task: Determine whether the fixed ten-Task Selection budget and five-Task future horizon structurally confound the current difficulty-Markov result, and separate task-count, calendar-duration, and evidence-availability meanings before more algorithm research.

definitions.selection_budget: The number of historical Task Checks in the compiled benchmark.
definitions.task_count_horizon: The first H eligible local Tasks after one frozen repository-local as-of cutoff.
definitions.calendar_duration: A source-capacity diagnostic counting eligible local Tasks arriving within a fixed number of days after the cutoff.
definitions.source_time_cutoff_safe_counterfactual: Cross-repository fitting uses only Task created_at values no later than the target cutoff, while public Agent labels remain projected to Task arrival.
definitions.strict_historical_replay: Every training Task and mature label was actually available by the target cutoff.
definitions.frozen_external_pretraining: A policy is frozen from non-target repositories at its own policy cutoff and then evaluated on a repository excluded from training.
definitions.retrospective_mechanism_probe: Complete non-target histories may be used for mechanism discovery, without supporting a historical deployability claim.

required_evidence: one common-Origin budget by task-count-horizon response surface
full-history contrast and equal-budget random calibration in every cell
repository-first wide and deep summaries in every cell
calendar span and fixed-duration source-capacity diagnostics
a decision that distinguishes a stable region from an isolated favorable cell
self-digested plan, result, and membership identities
insufficient_outcomes: choosing the best observed budget or horizon and reporting only that cell
changing the Origin cohort between cells in the primary response surface
counting overlapping Origins as independent repositories
calling projected public Agent labels strict prospective evidence
promoting a Selector or Runner default from this opened development grid
adding a new Selector, prior, state partition, training service, or runtime abstraction

common_origin_cohort.future_rule: Every horizon uses a prefix of the same next ten Tasks after the same cutoff.
common_origin_cohort.primary_weighting: Origins equal within repository, then repositories equal.
common_origin_cohort.overlap_policy: Horizon ten overlaps adjacent future windows because the Origin step is five; repository is the independent cluster and no Origin-count confidence claim is allowed.

selectors.rule: Select the most recent B local history Tasks.
Match the complete local-history five-state difficulty distribution with symmetric cell mass 0.2.
Reuse the exact five-state representation, repository-equal cutoff-aware transition prior, local prior strength five, and forecast for H steps before selecting B Tasks.

response_surface.training_repository_rule: Use the original seven wide repositories except the target repository; include only Tasks with created_at no later than the target cutoff.
response_surface.full_history: Primary no-Selection baseline in every cell.

horizon_diagnostics.calendar_duration_status: source-capacity diagnostic only; no time-horizon Selector is fitted

development_decision_rule.stable_region: All four difficulty-Markov cells in at least one adjacent two-budget by two-horizon rectangle meet every cell requirement.
development_decision_rule.isolated_cell: One or more cells meet every requirement but no stable region exists.
development_decision_rule.priority: A stable region may motivate a newly prespecified study only. No result may open the holdout, promote a Selector, or choose one observed cell as a default.

failure_model: A horizon-dependent Origin schedule changes the repository population instead of the estimand.
A budget equal to history creates a trivial zero contrast.
Short future blocks create a noisy target that favors hindsight or chance.
Long horizons remove repositories and mature training Origins.
Same-Agent state construction inflates response-derived Selection evidence.
An isolated favorable cell is mistaken for a supported operating range.
Raw created_at chronology is mistaken for attested Result availability.
Task-count horizons are mistaken for stable calendar durations.
stop_rule: After the complete frozen grid and audits, do not add another scale, threshold, state rule, or Selector on these opened outcomes. Reopen only with a new source, explicit user-demand evidence, or an independently derived mechanism.
